name: Daniel Felipe Galindo Arias
headline: Senior Offensive Security Consultant focused on Web/API, Active Directory, Android and IT/OT security assessments.
summary: Master in Information Security with more than 15 years of experience across cybersecurity, offensive security and technology risk management. I help organizations identify exploitable weaknesses, validate real attack paths and translate technical findings into actionable remediation plans for business and technical stakeholders. My work focuses on web/API, Active Directory, Android and IT/OT assessments, combining hands-on exploitation, evidence-based reporting and practical hardening guidance.
ethicsStatement: All offensive security activities documented in this portfolio were performed in authorized environments, public training platforms, personal labs or sanitized professional scenarios. No client-sensitive information, credentials, secrets or confidential data are disclosed.
professionalFocus: Web/API Security: authentication, authorization, business logic, file upload, SSRF, SQL injection and SOAP/WSDL testing.
Active Directory & Internal Pentest: attack path analysis, Kerberos abuse, credential exposure, AD CS and privilege escalation.
Android Security: APK review, static analysis, traffic interception, insecure storage and runtime testing.
IT/OT Security: segmentation reviews, exposure analysis, firewall rules and risk translation for operational environments.
Reporting & Remediation: executive summaries, technical evidence, risk narratives and prioritized remediation plans.

experience.role: Senior Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking Consultant
highlights: Led and supported offensive security assessments across web applications, APIs, corporate assets and enterprise environments, identifying exploitable weaknesses and validating realistic attack paths.
Performed manual vulnerability validation using offensive tooling, custom scripts and evidence-driven testing to separate exploitable risk from scanner noise.
Delivered executive and technical reports with attack narrative, business impact, proof of concept, affected assets and prioritized remediation guidance.
Conducted technical audits, vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities across corporate infrastructure and application environments.
Validated findings, prioritized remediation and documented technical evidence to support vulnerability management and risk reduction processes.
Supported security monitoring, incident documentation and stakeholder coordination, strengthening the connection between technical risk and operational impact.
Progressed from infrastructure and systems operations into cybersecurity responsibilities across business-critical enterprise environments.
Supported perimeter security, SSL certificate management, Git-based version control, infrastructure hardening and operational continuity initiatives.
Participated in technical security reviews, web service assessments and infrastructure risk analysis, building a hybrid foundation across operations, risk and offensive validation.

education: Master's Degree in Information Security - UNIR, Spain (2023)
Technology Degree in Computer and Network Assembly and Maintenance - SENA, Neiva (2012)
